AUTH_FIRST_FRAME: the first frame must be auth
AUTH_NO_FRAME_IN_TIME: no auth frame arrived in time
AUTH_TOKEN_REFUSED: daemon token refused; the host holds the current one
AUTH_TOO_MANY_BYTES: too many bytes before the auth frame
NO_PLACE_FILE: no place file here, so there is no host to dial; wsp join <address> --code <code> makes this computer a place
NO_TOKEN_AT_START: daemon refuses to start without an auth token
PLACE_LEAVE_ROAD_REFUSAL: place.leave is answered only on the link this computer opened to its host; run wsp leave here to take this computer out of a wsp
hostKeyRefusal: the host at http://192.168.1.20:7080 did not prove the key this computer learned at join; nothing was sent to it
linkCouldNotDial: http://192.168.1.20:7080 could not be dialled: connect ECONNREFUSED
linkLinked: linked to the host at http://192.168.1.20:7080
linkNoAnswerToDial: http://192.168.1.20:7080 did not answer the dial
linkNotAFrame: http://192.168.1.20:7080 sent something that is not a frame
linkQuiet: the host at http://192.168.1.20:7080 sent nothing for 30s; cutting the link and dialling again
linkRefused: http://192.168.1.20:7080: the host refused this place
linkUnreadableAuthReply: http://192.168.1.20:7080 answered place.auth with something this computer cannot read: connect ECONNREFUSED
notOnThisKind: not on this kind: this daemon serves a cloud machine, which reads neither its own load nor its own processes
portScopeRefusal: this socket is scoped to port 8123: only tunnel ops on it and ping are allowed
